title: Background Remover
h1: Remove Image Background Online — Free, Private, No Sign-up
seoTitle: Background Remover — Remove Image Background Free Online
description: Remove the background from any photo in seconds and download a transparent PNG or add a solid colour. Runs in your browser, so your picture is never uploaded.
intro: Upload a photo of a person, product or pet and the background disappears. Save it as a transparent PNG or put it on white, black or a colour. The AI runs on your own device, so your picture is never uploaded.
blurb: Remove the background from a photo and save a transparent PNG — free, private, no sign-up.
howItWorks: Click the upload area and choose a photo, or drag one in. Photos of people, products and animals work best.
Press Remove background. The first time, a small AI model downloads to your browser (about 25 MB), which can take a minute on a slow connection; after that it is much faster.
Pick a transparent, white or coloured background to preview it, then press Download PNG.
examples: Cut yourself out of a selfie to make a profile picture or sticker.
Put a product photo on a clean white background for an online shop listing.
Make a transparent PNG logo or cut-out to place on a poster or slide.

faq.q: Is my photo uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. The AI model runs inside your browser on your own device, so your photo is never sent anywhere. Only the model file itself is downloaded the first time.

faq.q: Why is it slow the first time?
faq.a: The first run downloads the AI model, about 25 MB, and your browser keeps it for next time. After that, removing a background usually takes a few seconds.

faq.q: What kind of photos work best?
faq.a: Clear photos where one person, product or animal stands out from the background. Cluttered scenes, hair against similar colours or glass and see-through objects can leave rough edges.

faq.q: Will it work on my phone?
faq.a: Yes on most modern Android phones and iPhones. Very old or low-memory phones may run out of memory, in which case try a smaller photo or a computer.

faq.q: How do I get a transparent background?
faq.a: Leave New background on Transparent and download the PNG. PNG is the format that keeps transparency, so the result can be placed over any other picture.
